# IREN_MKZ — Users, Services & Control-Plane Resources

**Selected host: `$node`.** Use the **Host** dropdown above to switch every host, user, service, filesystem, disk, and network panel between `site-management` (`192.0.2.4`, BCM/application services) and `site-controller` (`192.0.2.2`, Slurm head/NFS). The playful **Naughty vs Nice** list is strictly a measured resource ranking: 50% host CPU share + 40% host memory share + 10% disk-I/O intensity. It is not a conduct or security judgment. Collection records usernames and process names only; command arguments and environments are never read. `192.0.2.8` is a distinct Ubuntu host but is not currently an NFS server or an authorized telemetry target, so it is not presented as live data.
